entries.text: 嗯，差不多就這樣吧……[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_01

entries.text: 大約１年多前……
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_system_01

entries.text: 真老大找我商量的事，\n我整理得差不多了。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_02

entries.text: 商量？商量什麼了？[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_honooboss_01

entries.text: 首先是天星大作戰的事。\n……還有天星隊的隊規。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_03

entries.text: 最近夥伴變多了不是嗎？\n所以我們在討論隊裡需要個規則，\r\n就是該有個隊規。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_04

entries.text: 哦～！是皮拿你的話，\n應該會有好主意吧？[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_kakutouboss_01

entries.text: 哪有，這件事讓我壓力超大的。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_05

entries.text: 我以前會惹人反感，\n是因為當時我是學生會長……你們都知道吧？[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_06

entries.text: 你制定了一堆囉嗦的校規，\n讓學生們都反感到不行對吧。\r\n之後就立刻換其他人當了。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_honooboss_02

entries.text: 在下表示同意……\n後髮際的頭髮長度最多３公分等等。\r\n老實說，真是囉嗦透頂……[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_dokuboss_01

entries.text: 是吧？\n所以我根本就不適合去訂什麼隊規。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_07

entries.text: 可是啊，平時幾乎都是\n皮拿在照顧隊員不是嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_fairyboss_02

entries.text: 大家都很依靠皮拿，\n而且都很信賴你。[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_kakutouboss_02

entries.text: 如果是現在的皮拿想出的隊規，\n我也覺得遵守倒是無妨。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_honooboss_03

entries.text: 好啦好啦，我知道了。\n隊規我來訂……我來訂就是了。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_08

entries.text: 能做的事……\n我已經做得夠多了吧……[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_09

entries.text: 何況這是我自己訂的隊規，\n我會瀟灑地離開天星隊的。\r\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳能收下這個老大之證團隊徽章嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_10

entries.text: 還有這個超酷的\n招式學習器也拿去吧。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_waza_01

entries.text: 啊～啊～\n這麼看來派對也the end了……[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_11

entries.text: 話說回來，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的每一隻寶可夢都太猛了吧。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_12

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳那是在學院裡學的嗎？\n讓寶可夢學會的招式或培育方法之類的。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_13

entries.text: 是的
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_select_01

entries.text: 不是
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_select_02

entries.text: 哦……\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳到學院上學，覺得快樂嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_14

entries.text: 很快樂
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_select_03

entries.text: 不快樂
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_select_04

entries.text: 你就是皮拿嗎？[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_nelke_01

entries.text: 髮型酷炫的不速之客？\n以寶可夢的招式來說，就像是惡意追擊？[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_16

entries.text: 我想和你稍微談談。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_nelke_02

entries.text: ……總覺得怪麻煩的。\n但反正我閒下來了，ＯＫ喔。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_17

entries.text: [EMPTY 62]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_nelke_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 62]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_18

entries.text: [EMPTY 62]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_19

entries.text: [EMPTY 62]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_nelke_04

entries.text: [EMPTY 62]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_nelke_05

entries.text: [EMPTY 62]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_nelke_06

entries.text: [EMPTY 62]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_20

entries.text: [EMPTY 62]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_21

entries.text: [EMPTY 62]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_nelke_07

entries.text: [EMPTY 62]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_22

entries.text: 好的。\n我就開門見山地問。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_nelke_08

entries.text: 這樣下去的話，\n你們所有人都會受到退學處分吧。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_nelke_09

entries.text: 為什麼不解散天星隊，\n到學院上學呢？[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_nelke_10

entries.text: 你偏要問這個？\n我們只是在等同伴而已。\r\n……雖然不知道這個同伴會不會回來。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_23

entries.text: 同伴……是很重要的夥伴嗎？[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_nelke_11

entries.text: [EMPTY 62]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_24

entries.text: [EMPTY 62]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_nelke_12

entries.text: 這個同伴就是天星隊最強的老大。\n以訓練家來說，就像是首席冠軍？[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_25

entries.text: 這個人邀請大家一起建立天星隊，\n被稱為真老大。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_26

entries.text: 這個真老大，現在人在哪裡？[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_nelke_13

entries.text: 我要是知道就不會頭痛了。\n有一年半左右了吧？想聯絡都聯絡不上。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_27

entries.text: [EMPTY 62]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_nelke_14

entries.text: 我一直以為只要我不退出天星隊，\n或許哪一天真老大就會聯絡我了。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_28

entries.text: 老師們一直囉嗦著要我退出天星隊，\n還出現了像你們這樣的傢伙……[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_29

entries.text: 反而是我被拋下了嗎……\n說起來真老大以前就想解散天星隊……[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_30

entries.text: 真老大和天星隊\n真的有那麼重要嗎？[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_nelke_16

entries.text: 那還用說。\n如果用學院常說的話，就像是……\r\n寶物？[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_aku_040_akuboss_31
